commit 28131e06d37e84229eaeea82b0c46f4ed14ae7e8
Author:     Martin Giger <martin@humanoids.be>
AuthorDate: Thu Feb 20 18:13:46 2025 +0000
Commit:     Martin Giger <martin@humanoids.be>
CommitDate: Thu Feb 20 18:13:46 2025 +0000

    Bug 1949527 - Specify special jsdoc tags in custom element documentation. r=aleca
    
    Adding the preferred versions of them to the eslint config, so the shortened versions can automatically be corrected.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D238987

diff --git a/.eslintrc.js b/.eslintrc.js
index 0ab210f3e3a..83969aaf288 100644
--- a/.eslintrc.js
+++ b/.eslintrc.js
@@ -44,6 +44,13 @@ module.exports = {
     // eslint-plugin-mozilla, we turn off processing of the html plugin for .xml
     // files.
     "html/xml-extensions": [".xhtml"],
+    jsdoc: {
+      tagNamePreference: {
+        attr: "attribute",
+        cssprop: "cssproperty",
+        tag: "tagname",
+      },
+    },
   },
   // Ignore eslint configurations in parent directories.
   root: true,
@@ -190,7 +197,6 @@ module.exports = {
             definedTags: [
               "attribute",
               "cssproperty",
-              "property",
               "part",
               "slot",
               "tagname",
diff --git a/docs/frontend/custom_element_conventions.md b/docs/frontend/custom_element_conventions.md
index f70f7d499dd..907264f9fdc 100644
--- a/docs/frontend/custom_element_conventions.md
+++ b/docs/frontend/custom_element_conventions.md
@@ -15,7 +15,8 @@
   should be imported in the element's module.
 - External features of the custom element (attributes, slots, parts, css custom
   properties, events etc.) are documented using these jsdoc tags:
-  https://custom-elements-manifest.open-wc.org/analyzer/getting-started/#supported-jsdoc
+  https://custom-elements-manifest.open-wc.org/analyzer/getting-started/#supported-jsdoc.
+  We currently support the following subset of extra tags: `@attribute`, `@cssproperty`, `@part`, `@slot`, and `@tagname`. Of course standard JSDoc tags used by custom element manifest like `@fires` and `@property` work as well.
 - For events the `handleEvents` method callback should be used, and just the
   `this` reference is passed to `addEventListener`. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/EventTarget/addEventListener#the_event_listener_callback
   - This also lets us modify event handling through inheritance.
diff --git a/mail/base/content/widgets/search-bar.mjs b/mail/base/content/widgets/search-bar.mjs
index 52bf97591d9..ac0dc8e2f2d 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/widgets/search-bar.mjs
+++ b/mail/base/content/widgets/search-bar.mjs
@@ -8,10 +8,10 @@
  *
  * @tagname search-bar
  *
- * @property {string} label - Search field label for accessibility tree.
- * @property {boolean} disabled - When present, disable the search field and
+ * @attribute {string} label - Search field label for accessibility tree.
+ * @attribute {boolean} disabled - When present, disable the search field and
  *   button.
- * @property {number} maxlength - Max length of the input in the search field.
+ * @attribute {number} maxlength - Max length of the input in the search field.
  *
  * @slot placeholder - Content displayed as placeholder. When not provided, the
  *   value of the label attribute is shown as placeholder.
